findings: THE ANSWER IS NO. The best shared-body cell under C-0087's measured dropout reads 0.2403 of the stroke at the 90th percentile on C-0015's 6 x 15 attachment grid with RIGID ties of 1000 pN/nm, against T-5b's 0.10 and against the array's own best of 0.5327 on the same station sets — a factor of 2.22.

F1, THE DECLARED FALSIFIER, did NOT fire. A perfectly rigid shared body at C-0063's 34 stations dishes 0.0344 to 0.0702 of the stroke at ZERO defects over the tie ladder, against the array's 0.0706 at the same stations and T-5b's 0.10.

THE ESCAPE IS A DIVISION AND IT IS WORTH 3.4x OF LOCAL SUPPORT. C-0017's mandate is a SUM over an array's paths, so at 34 paths every station is held at 0.9804 pN/nm. Under a shared body the same mandate is supplied by the body's own GROUND, which is a rigid-body mode of the tile and therefore invisible to dishing, and what caps a tie is the per-path FORCE allowable instead: 3.3333 pN/nm at C-0049's 10 pN and the acceptable 3 nm stroke.

F2 FIRED, AND IT FIRED BECAUSE AN AMPLIFICATION IS A RATIO. The best shared-body cell amplifies by 20.96 under one missing tie where the array cells amplify by 2.06 to 7.10 — but the ABSOLUTE worst single removal is 0.1392 of the stroke against the array's 0.3778 on the same station set, i.e. 2.71x BETTER. A topology that improves its own zero-defect baseline by more than it improves its worst case reports a worse amplification while being absolutely better, and the ratio is the wrong statistic to declare a falsifier on.

AND THE COUNT ARGUMENT SURVIVES THE TOPOLOGY. Over 15/30/45/60/90/135/180 paths the rigid shared body's 90th percentile runs 0.8208 -> 0.5261 -> 0.3832 -> 0.3995 -> 0.2403 -> 0.1446 -> 0.1202 against the array's 0.8522 -> 0.6690 -> 0.6142 -> 0.6123 -> 0.5327 -> 0.4580 -> 0.4335 — uniformly better, and with a redundancy slope of -0.784 against -0.265, i.e. 3.0x steeper in d ln p90 / d ln n. That steeper slope is the topology's real gift and it is still not enough: the fit crosses T-5b's 0.10 at 252 ties, an extrapolation only 1.40x beyond the densest grid measured, against the 53 upward crossover sites C-0066 counts at phase 24 — 4.8x short, where C-0089's array is 5.7x short of 34 by an independent run-length division that demands 195. The escape changes the LEVEL by 2.4x and leaves the COUNT of the same order.

CH-0081 INVERTS WHEN THE MANDATE IS MASSED. Its 22.414 nm is (48 EI / k)^(1/3) at k = mandate/34, and a flexure span goes as n^(1/3), so concentrating the mandate on n ground elements shortens it by (34/n)^(1/3). On the one-support family 2 of 7 counts place inside C-0069's 8.19 nm budget with a per-element force inside the 48 pN shear allowable: n=1: 4.36 nm, 100.0 pN; n=2: 5.49 nm, 50.0 pN; n=4: 6.92 nm, 25.0 pN; n=6: 7.92 nm, 16.7 pN; n=10: 9.39 nm, 10.0 pN; n=15: 10.75 nm, 6.7 pN; n=34: 14.12 nm, 2.9 pN. The plan obstruction that killed the flexure branch is a consequence of DIVIDING the mandate, not of the mandate.

WHAT THE SHARED BODY COSTS IS A SECOND LAYER, AND THAT IS A SPECIFICATION GAP RATHER THAN A PHYSICS ONE. 3 of 7 buildability rows do not clear: the same, at the stroke the device traverses; ties the density fit demands, against the upward sites the lattice has; does §3 describe a two-layer tile?. The motif itself is the ONE in this neighbourhood with a published precedent — C-0055 records that square-lattice multilayer origami ties its added duplex at many sites and is rigid, and it is the single-tie ARM this programme has no precedent for.

THE BODY'S OWN RIGIDITY IS THE SECOND-ORDER QUESTION. Against the rigid limit the condensed station compliance is RIGID x1.000; four-layer honeycomb brick x1.564; single-layer Gen-1 sheet x2.311, so the body's own compliance is a first-order design variable and the rigid limit is optimistic.
